pages.title: A obra e a situação

work.title: Mystic Pizza
work.note: Mystic Pizza é um filme dirigido por Donald Petrie, sobre três amigas que trabalham numa pizzaria de uma cidade à beira-mar A referência é o filme da pizzaria: with or without onions?.

pages.question: Como a história dessa obra ajuda você a imaginar a situação de hoje? Diga uma ideia em inglês.

facts.label: Situação
facts.sub: Calling a pizza place can feel scary at first. The call is short and always follows the same steps: size, kind, extras, your name and the wait time.

facts.big: In the USA, “takeout” means food you take away from the restaurant.
facts.label: Fato cultural

facts.big: On the phone, the restaurant asks for your name for the order.
facts.label: Fato cultural
facts.sub: They write it on the box or bag so you can find your order.

pages.title: Pizza for three · 1/3
paragraphs: Friday night in **Newark**. Abe and his two friends are hungry. They want pizza, and nobody wants to cook. Abe picks up the phone.

“Joe’s Pizza. **How can I help you?**” a woman says. Abe answers, “**Hi. I’d like a large pizza for takeout.**” “**What kind of pizza?**” “**Half cheese, half pepperoni.**” One friend likes mushrooms, but Abe says, “Not today!”
pages.prompt: Onde começa e o que acontece?

pages.title: Pizza for three · 2/3
paragraphs: “**Anything else?**” she asks. “**A bottle of soda, please.**” She answers, “**It’ll be twenty minutes.**” “**Great. My name is Sam**,” Abe says. “Your order will be ready soon,” she says. Abe says thank you and ends the call.
Twenty minutes later, they walk to the shop. The smell is wonderful. The box is warm in Abe’s hands. “**Pizza’s here!**” he says. They laugh and sit in the park to eat.

pages.title: Pizza for three · 3/3
paragraphs: Abe remembers the film Mystic Pizza. In it, three young women work at a small pizza place. The place is the heart of their town. “**This hits the spot**,” says one friend. Abe smiles. A simple phone call, and a perfect Friday.

items.why: Takeout = food you take with you.

items.q: The order will be ready soon. O que significa “soon”?
items.why: Soon = in a short time.

items.q: This hits the spot! O que significa “hits the spot”?
items.why: Hits the spot = perfectly satisfying.
